question: How strong is Lye?
answer:
I think he's among the strongest of the Sin Archbishops, about on par with Sirius.

I think it's difficult to say a fight starts with a simple “Ready, set, go.”

For example, within Emilia's Camp, Garfiel is the strongest in close combat, Emilia is stronger at mid-range, and Roswaal is stronger at long range.

With that in mind, Lye is an all-rounder who can use the techniques of those he's devoured through the Authority of Gluttony, so you could call him a jack-of-all-trades, master of none.

Even so, the fact that he can adapt to almost any situation makes him quite strong.

Most of the Sin Archbishops' abilities are designed to catch opponents off guard, while their basic combat ability isn't actually all that extraordinary. So when it comes purely to combat ability, I think Lye is among the strongest Sin Archbishops.

He's strong enough to rank near the top in most countries, and he can sometimes beat one of the Nine Divine Generals and sometimes lose to them. Cecilus kills him, though. (laughs)
